body:
## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `priority:p1` · `domain:spec` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. A new section-heading key, built at the judgment tier

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T10:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1:** this is the wall under objectstack-ai/objectui#12192 (p1), which is the wall under objectstack-ai/cloud#2775 (p1, the maintainer's). A wall inherits the level (`filing-gate.md:42`).
- **Why the queue, not the decision box:** the need is ruled. The maintainer accepted the wording (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 3). The 2026-10-12 ruling on #23016 says product pages stay metadata, with no product-specific widgets. What remains is the key's shape, which is the spec lane's work at the judgment tier (`Clause-②: yes`, a new accepted key).
- **Constraints on the shape:**
  - It is generic: a count of any multi-value field's values on the current record, ⛔ not a cloud-only case.
  - It survives the i18n path, so a translated named-section label can carry it.
  - It is strict at parse: a heading naming a field the object does not declare is refused at publish.
  - ⛔ No second template dialect. #19939 retires the `{var}` dialect in v18, so the shape uses a form the platform keeps.
- The renderer half stays on objectstack-ai/objectui#12192, which reads the key once it lands. Delivery to cloud rides objectstack-ai/cloud#2709.
- Triage: lands in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (`domain:spec`); rationale: a new published key.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#23013: a `record:details` section heading can name the count of a multi-value field's values on the current record; the spec half of objectstack-ai/objectui#12192) · 2026-10-12T14:07Z
Session: `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-23013-section-heading-count`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23013`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#2` (seat post #18549)
File surface (at `origin/main` `df7a137923` or later; stop on breach and explain in the report): `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (`RecordDetailsProps.sections[]`) and its tests; the publish-time check that refuses a heading naming an undeclared field, wherever the measured door for page-to-object field references lives (`packages/spec` or `packages/lint`, both this lane's); `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` (the new key's row, `planned`, carrier objectstack-ai/objectui#12192); the i18n extraction path, if a translated named-section label must carry the count; the generated artifacts `check:generated` names; one `.changeset/23013-*.md`. ⛔ Not objectui.
Container & model: `M` (a new key with a cross-reference check and an i18n leg), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate"; `Clause-②` suspect on `packages/spec/src/**`). It owes a review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the queue, by an isolated at-tier subagent.
Clause-②: yes (widening: a new accepted key)
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
Thread-read: 6122902128
Serial constraints cleared (all 15 open PRs' file lists read at 2026-10-12T14:00Z): no open PR and no in-flight claim touches `packages/spec/src/ui/**` or `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`. #23016 (claimed in this round, same seat) also adds rows to `liveness/page.json` and touches `page.zod.ts`, not `component.zod.ts`. The two are ordinary concurrency on that one ledger file, and the later lander resolves the conflict.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `zhuangjianguo`.
